pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit consecutive entries in a falling or rising knife market state; require at least 50% profit realization on the foundational position before micro-scaling.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero-entry during high-impact structural price velocity spikes unless Order Flow Imbalance and ATR expansion validate a breakout rather than a liquidity wick.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively trigger trailing stop-lock or partial harvest when open profit crosses +$4.50 to guarantee adherence to the $15-$30 target profile without giving back floating gains.
